units.source_text: 可是，这也并非毫无问题。

en.t: But this was not entirely without problems.

units.source_text: 例如，那个高高的瞭望哨。

en.t: For example, there was that tall lookout post.

units.source_text: 而且，他担心发现他逃走的女人，万一大声叫嚷起来，

en.t: Moreover, he was afraid that if the woman discovered he had escaped and started shouting loudly,

units.source_text: 在他逃出村之前，那些家伙们会先把村落的口子封闭起来。

en.t: before he could get out of the village, those people would block off the village exits first.

units.source_text: 这两点，最终也许能够归纳出一个问题。

en.t: These two points, in the end, might perhaps be reduced to a single problem.

units.source_text: 一开始搬运大网篮的家伙们送来水和定期的配给品，总在日落之后很久。

en.t: The men who had first carried the large rope baskets always brought water and the regular supplies long after sunset.

units.source_text: 女人如果要把他的逃亡在那以前说出来，只能通过瞭望哨的监视人。

en.t: If the woman wanted to report his escape before then, she could only do it through the watchman at the lookout post.

units.source_text: 于是，问题集中到“如何对付瞭望哨上的监视”这一点上来。

en.t: Thus the problem came down to one point: how to deal with the surveillance from the lookout post.
